<h2 style="text-align: center;"><span data-ccp-props="{"134233279":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"><span class="EOP SCXW8422268 BCX0" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"><span class="TextRun Highlight SCXW230026277 BCX0" lang="EN" xml:lang="EN" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW230026277 BCX0">Poly Packing Tape FAQs</span></span></span></span></h2>
<p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">What is the</span></strong><strong><span data-contrast="auto"> </span></strong><strong><span data-contrast="auto">difference</span></strong><strong><span data-contrast="auto"> between poly packing tape and shipping tape?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="auto">Packing tape has a sturdy adhesive that can withstand cold and hot weather conditions. </span><span data-contrast="auto">It is recommended for sealing and protecting large packages that </span><span data-contrast="auto">will be</span><span data-contrast="auto"> moved throughout different locations and be exposed to all kinds of weather</span><span data-contrast="auto">. Shipping tape is used to seal </span><span data-contrast="auto">pac</span><span data-contrast="auto">kages that will be handled by different people, such as envelopes or small boxes that might go through rough handling.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p>
<p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">How long will the poly packing tape last?</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="auto">The poly packing tape </span><span data-contrast="auto">is durable enough to seal large boxes. The standard 2 mil. the tape can protect up to 35 lbs, while the heavy-duty keeps 50 lbs. packages tamper-proof. </span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p>
<p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">How do I apply the poly packing tape to my package? </span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p>
<p><span data-contrast="auto">Use a </span><span data-contrast="auto">tape gun</span><span data-contrast="auto"> to quickly apply the poly packing tape to the package. Follow the steps below for fast application:</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p>
<ol>
<li><span data-contrast="auto">Push the poly packing tape onto</span><span data-contrast="auto"> the wheel of </span><span data-contrast="auto">the gun.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233279":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></li>
<li><span data-contrast="auto">Pull between 5 to 6 inches of the tape from the poly packing tape roll. It should unwind with the sticky area facing down. </span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233279":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></li>
<li><span data-contrast="auto">Position the unrolled tape</span><span data-contrast="auto">'s front end between the r</span><span data-contrast="auto">oller </span><span data-contrast="auto">and the metal guide.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233279":true,"201341983":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></li>
<li><span data-contrast="auto">Pull the tape under the roller before cutting off the excess poly packing tape.</span></li>
</ol>            </div>
